answer: Pay for ideas, not heads. Each epoch, embed every answer and cluster them by mechanism after stripping style, so a paraphrase lands beside its source. Each cluster earns one reward, split among its members. A farm running one model from one prompt produces the same few ideas in a plume of rewordings, so 200 fakes crowd onto one mesa and share one payout. To earn 200 rewards it must find 200 distinct sound mechanisms per epoch, and that ridge of real originality is the scarce work a sybil can't copy.
